title: Component contract
description: One component's anatomy, independent of any platform: the parts it's made of, and which design token sets each part's design properties in its resting look, its states and its breakpoints. A contract holds only token references; the values live in tokens.json.

id.description: The component's name. Its own tokens, if any, are az.component.<id>.*, and the contract must use every one of them.

sources.description: Where the decisions come from: reviewed pull requests, design files.

part.description: A part of the component. The root is the component itself.

states.description: What changes in an interaction state. Only what changes.

breakpoints.description: What changes from a breakpoint's width up (sm 576px, md 768px, lg 992px, xl 1200px, xxl 1400px). Only what changes.

tokens.description: Design properties, named the way tokens are (color, fill, padding.x, font.size, underline.offset), each set by a design token.

additionalProperties.description: A reference to a token in tokens.json.
